---
title: "Personal Visualization Journey"
---

## Setup and data import

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

scrobbles <- read_csv(
  "scrobbles-ramenez-le-1793670467.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    listened_at = with_tz(as_datetime(uts), "America/Chicago"),
    date = as.Date(listened_at, tz = "America/Chicago"),
    month = floor_date(date, "month"),
    hour = hour(listened_at),
    weekday = wday(listened_at, label = TRUE, week_start = 1)
  
  )
dim(scrobbles)
```

## Prepare the monthly listening data

```{r}
# Exclude incomplete boundary months
months <- seq.Date(
  as.Date("2025-09-01"),
  as.Date("2026-10-01"),
  by = "month"
)

listening <- scrobbles %>%
  filter(month %in% months)

# Identify the 12 most-played artists
top_artists <- listening %>%
  count(artist, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 12) %>%
  pull(artist)

# Calculate monthly artist shares
heatmap <- crossing(month = months, artist = top_artists) %>%
  left_join(
    listening %>%
      count(month, artist, name = "artist_plays"),
    by = c("month", "artist")
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    listening %>%
      count(month, name = "monthly_plays"),
    by = "month"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    share = if_else(
      is.na(monthly_plays),
      NA_real_,
      replace_na(artist_plays, 0L) / monthly_plays
    ),
    artist = factor(artist, levels = rev(top_artists)),
    month_id = factor(
      format(month, "%Y-%m"),
      levels = format(months, "%Y-%m")
    )
  )

# Month labels, with years where appropriate
month_labels <- if_else(
  seq_along(months) == 1 | month(months) == 1,
  format(months, "%b\n%Y"),
  format(months, "%b")
)

# Identify exceptional monthly listening shares
peaks <- heatmap %>%
  filter(!is.na(share), share >= 0.09)

# Identify the missing month
missing_x <- which(
  levels(heatmap$month_id) == "2026-08"
)
```

## Version 1 visualization

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-alt: "Heatmap of the 12 most-played artists from September 2025 to October 2026. Darker teal indicates higher monthly listening shares, with four peaks highlighted in orange. August 2026 has no records."

paper <- "#FBFAF6"

plot1 <- ggplot(heatmap, aes(month_id, artist)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = share), width = 0.94, height = 0.86) +

  # Missing month
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = missing_x - 0.47, xmax = missing_x + 0.47,
    ymin = 0.57, ymax = length(top_artists) + 0.43,
    fill = "#DCD8CE"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = missing_x, y = (length(top_artists) + 1) / 2,
    label = "NO RECORDS", angle = 90,
    color = "#596970", fontface = "bold", size = 3
  ) +

  # Highlight monthly shares of at least 9%
  geom_tile(
    data = peaks, fill = NA, color = "#DF784F",
    linewidth = 0.8, width = 0.94, height = 0.86
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = peaks,
    aes(label = scales::percent(share, accuracy = 0.1)),
    color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 3
  ) +

  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.6) +

  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c(
      "#EFF4EF", "#C9DDDA", "#8DB9BA",
      "#3F8692", "#0B4659"
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.02, 0.04, 0.07, 0.10)),
    limits = c(0, 0.10),
    breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.10),
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    na.value = "#DCD8CE",
    name = "Share of monthly plays"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = set_names(month_labels, format(months, "%Y-%m")),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    direction = "horizontal",
    title.position = "top",
    barwidth = grid::unit(4.5, "cm"),
    barheight = grid::unit(0.3, "cm")
  )) +

  labs(
    title = "Evolution of most-listened artists",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Across 13 recorded months, no artist reached",
      "10% of a month's listening."
    ),
    x = NULL, y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Each tile shows an artist's share of all monthly plays; only the 12 most-played artists are displayed.",
      "Orange outlines indicate shares of at least 9%. August 2026 has no records.",
      "Source: Personal Last.fm listening history from Sep 2025–Oct 2026",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = paper, color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = paper, color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20, face = "bold", color = "#18323D"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11, color = "#596970",
      margin = margin(b = 12)
    ),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 9.5, color = "#18323D"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 9, color = "#18323D",
      margin = margin(t = 6)
    ),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),

    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),

    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 8.5, color = "#596970",
      hjust = 0, lineheight = 1.2,
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 18, 12, 12)
  )

plot1

```

## Version 2 visualization

```{r}
leaders <- heatmap %>%
  filter(!is.na(share)) %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  slice_max(artist_plays, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

highest <- leaders %>%
  slice_max(share, n = 1)

lowest <- leaders %>%
  slice_min(share, n = 1)

leaders %>%
  select(month, artist, artist_plays, share)

```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-alt: "Heatmap showing the twelve most-played artists from September 2025 to October 2026. Orange outlines identify the most-played artist each month. The highest and lowest monthly leader shares are labeled. August 2026 has no records."

paper <- "#FBFAF6"
ink <- "#18323D"
accent <- "#DF784F"

plot2 <- ggplot(heatmap, aes(month_id, artist)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = share), width = 0.94, height = 0.86) +

  # Month with no recorded plays
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = missing_x - 0.47, xmax = missing_x + 0.47,
    ymin = 0.57, ymax = length(top_artists) + 0.43,
    fill = "#DCD8CE"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = missing_x, y = (length(top_artists) + 1) / 2,
    label = "NO RECORDS", angle = 90,
    color = "#596970", fontface = "bold", size = 3
  ) +

  # Identify each month's most-played artist
  geom_tile(
    data = leaders, fill = NA, color = accent,
    linewidth = 0.7, width = 0.94, height = 0.86
  ) +

  # Label only the highest and lowest leader shares
  geom_text(
    data = highest,
    aes(label = scales::percent(share, accuracy = 0.1)),
    color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 3
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = lowest,
    aes(label = scales::percent(share, accuracy = 0.1)),
    color = ink, fontface = "bold", size = 3
  ) +

  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.6) +

  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c(
      "#EFF4EF", "#C9DDDA", "#8DB9BA",
      "#3F8692", "#0B4659"
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.02, 0.04, 0.07, 0.10)),
    limits = c(0, 0.10),
    breaks = c(0, 0.05, 0.10),
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    na.value = "#DCD8CE",
    name = "Share of monthly plays"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = set_names(month_labels, format(months, "%Y-%m")),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    direction = "horizontal",
    title.position = "top",
    barwidth = grid::unit(4.5, "cm"),
    barheight = grid::unit(0.3, "cm")
  )) +

  labs(
    title = "Evolution of most-listened artists",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Across 13 recorded months, no artist reached",
      "10% of a month's listening."
    ),
    x = NULL, y = NULL,
    caption = paste(
      "Each tile shows an artist's share of all monthly plays; only the 12 most-played artists are displayed.",
      "Orange outlines mark each month's top artist; the highest and lowest leading shares are labeled. August 2026 has no records.",
      "Source: Personal Last.fm listening history from Sep 2025–Oct 2026",
      sep = "\n"
    )
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = paper, color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20, face = "bold", color = ink
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 11, color = "#596970",
      margin = margin(b = 12)
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9.5, color = ink),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 9, color = ink, margin = margin(t = 6)
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.caption.position = "plot",
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 8.5, color = "#596970", hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(t = 12)
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 18, 12, 12)
  )

plot2

ggsave(
  "pvj-version-11-9.png",
  plot2,
  width = 14, height = 9,
  dpi = 300, bg = paper
)
```
